purpose: Authentic NASA data resource registry with provenance, access model, and telemetry-separation boundaries for AETHERION (Q-0107).
safety_notice: All resources listed here are historical, experimental, or reference research archives. None provide live astronaut telemetry or clinical diagnosis.

resources.name: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR)
resources.license_or_terms: Public NASA open-science data; attribution and DOI citation required per dataset
sub_components: Ames Life Sciences Data Archive (ALSDA: physiological, phenotypic, bioimaging, behavioral, hardware, environmental telemetry)
Environmental Data Application & RadLab radiation database

example_verified_studies.focus: Mouse heart transcriptomics after 30-day ISS spaceflight
Human aortic smooth muscle cells (HASMCs) 3-day ISS RNA-Seq
Human microvascular endothelial cells (HMEC-1) microgravity vs space radiation
Mouse bone single-cell RNA-seq across age groups in spaceflight

limitations: Most datasets are from model organisms (rodents, Drosophila, cell cultures) or historical studies, not live astronaut vitals.
Detailed dataset selection, species, assay type, and units are tracked in Q-0109.

resources.name: NASA Life Sciences Portal (NLSP)
resources.license_or_terms: NASA HRP portal; de-identified human research data (LSDA) and restricted astronaut surveillance (LSAH) for authorized NASA affiliates
sub_components: Life Sciences Data Archive (LSDA: spaceflight & ground-analog studies since 1961)
Lifetime Surveillance of Astronaut Health (LSAH: medical monitoring surveillance, restricted access)
limitations: LSAH astronaut medical monitoring data is restricted to NASA employees/affiliates and is not publicly downloadable.
De-identified historical LSDA records must never be presented as live crew telemetry.

resources.name: NASA Human Research Program (HRP) — Five Hazards of Human Spaceflight
resources.license_or_terms: NASA public domain / official educational & research documentation
limitations: Provides hazard taxonomy and physiological risk framing, not patient-level measurements.

resources.name: NASA Integrated Medical Model (IMM) — CliFF 119 (2023)
resources.license_or_terms: Original NASA documents; not automatically relicensed under Apache-2.0
sub_components: 100-condition baseline vs 119-condition Clinical Findings & Facts (CliFF 119, 2023) collection
limitations: No PDFs are imported or SHA-256 verified in this repository yet (see knowledge/nasa/cliff_119_2023/README.md).
Risk-planning reference only, not a clinically validated treatment protocol.
